text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Pardon the intrusion~! Cheva-chi~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Let's go eat Dubai chocolate parfaits~♡

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah... If you're looking for Cheval-san, 
she's out. Said she wouldn't be back for a 
while.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
No way~! And after I messaged her on LANE 
too~. Mmph............

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I really wanted to soak in those Dubai 
vibes... Going by myself would be totally 
boring~.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if someone would come with 
me~...?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Well then, how about I keep you 
company?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yay♪ You're so sweet, Shion-san~♡

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, look at this line! The back of the 
queue is... over by that sign, huh.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah... "Queue closed for today"...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Funyaaa~!! Too late again~~~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
That makes three times, three whole times! 
Waaah, the Dubai chocolate parfait feels 
so far away~.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Is it really that popular!? It looks like 
a regular chocolate parfait, so is there a 
secret to it?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You don't know about it, Shion-san? Dubai 
chocolate. It blew up on social media 
because of its crunchy pistachio texture!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Sweets inspired by it are trending like 
crazy in Dubai and all over the world 
right now!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
That's why I ab-so-lutely had to try it! I 
was refreshing the official Umastagram 
every day too, jeez~!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Every day... You really gave it your all. 
And even though it's your third try... it 
still ended up like this...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Sigh... I really wanted to feel like a 
Dubai celeb with that parfait...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
The parfait was a miss, but... isn't there 
something else that could give you that 
Dubai vibe?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I'll tag along! Let's go enjoy that Dubai 
celebrity feeling!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking down the tree-lined path, 
the clicking sound of heels echoing off 
cobblestones came from the direction of 
the school gate.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, the pics we took at the marina 
turned out super Instagrammable~♪

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. With that white yacht in the 
background, it looked remarkably 
high-class.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Wh-What...!? Vivlos and... Shion-san!?
choice_data_list: What are you doing dressed like that!?
What are you doing in those outfits!?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, we're Dubai celebrities♪

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...And I am serving as her attendant.
choice_data_list:
So, uh... playing dress-up like celebs, 
basically?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yup~! We took photos at the marina~, and 
went boutique shopping too~♪

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Though with me being unfamiliar with 
high-end designer boutiques, my escorting 
was rather clumsy.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Hey, Vivlos! Dragging Shion-san 
into your whims like that...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
No, no, I was the one who suggested it! I 
said we should go experience that 
celebrity feeling.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I play princess with my younger sisters 
all the time anyway. So honestly, I had a 
blast!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
......I'm your roommate, Shion-san. You 
really didn't need to put up with Vivlos 
too...
choice_data_list: Didn't Vivlos actually ask you first?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Tee-hee☆ But Cheva-chi wasn't around~! So 
I just pampered myself with Shion-san♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I love Shion-san~♡

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry, Shion-san! Vivlos caused 
you so much trouble...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Mmph. Then how about this, Cheva-chi? Will 
you come with me for parfaits next time?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Fine, I will.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu! Cheval-san, you really are a 
proper "big sister" after all~!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... In that case, next time let's do 
something that Cheval-san wants to do!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Treating sisters equally! That's how I do 
it with my little sisters too. Now then, 
what would you like to do~?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh!? ...N-No, um, that's...—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah, feel free to take your time thinking 
about it. I shall await your word, Milady 
Cheval.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
! ...Ah... um... I-I'll... think about 
it...
